item.title: GTA 6 is Playable on Xbox One, Rockstar Officially Confirms
item.description: In a surprise late-stage twist, it looks like Grand Theft Auto 6 will be coming to the Xbox One after all. While the impending mega-hit was previously announced only for Xbox Series consoles and PlayStation 5, the game is also arriving on Xbox’s last-gen console.

item.title: Marathon’s Big PvE Update Is Starting to Look a Lot Like Destiny
item.description: Since Marathon was released this March, developer Bungie has spent the majority of the year updating and tweaking the extraction shooter to make it more welcoming to a wider audience. This is largely part of a push to evolve the game after the studio revealed it hadn't met initial expectations. Following the Nightfall refresh in October, the game is set to change even more with the upcoming Symbiosis update on Dec. 8. Bungie has just shared a ton of new details and some of the additions seem very familiar.

item.title: GTA 6 Officially Breaks Pre-order Records on PlayStation and Xbox Stores
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 has broken pre-order records on both the PlayStation and Xbox stores as it's already one of 2026's top-selling games.

item.title: Official GTA 6 Update Is Bad News For PC Players
item.description: In Early October, reports suggested that Rockstar parent company Take-Two worked out a deal for exclusive game streaming rights that could bring Grand Theft Auto 6 to PC platforms. At the time, Microsoft denied the rumors. A month later, Rockstar itself has squashed all hope that GTA 6 might be playable day one on PC platforms.

item.title: All Heart Containers and Pieces of Heart locations in Ocarina of Time
item.description: Heart Containers and Pieces of Heart give you more health in Ocarina of Time. Here's where to find all of them, so you can max out your health.

item.title: Valve Just Added a Huge Feature for Steam Deck Owners
item.description: Valve revealed a new feature that makes it much easier to check whether a game runs well on the Steam Deck . In addition to existing compatibility information, like controller support, the Steam Deck Compatibility section on Steam now shows the average frames per second that players are getting on the Steam Deck OLED .

item.title: How to get the Scarecrow Song in Ocarina of Time
item.description: In The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, the Scarecrow Song is an optional but useful song you can unlock to help you get to otherwise impossible to reach places. You don't need the song to beat the game, but you will need it to get every Piece of Heart and Skulltula Token .

item.title: BoJack Horseman: A Top Animated Season in TV History
item.description: Occasionally, a TV show will come out that sticks with viewers even after they have finished watching it. Some seasons are even powerful enough to "enter the cultural zeitgeist as some of the best seasons. Shows like Breaking Bad , True Detective , and The Sopranos are all considered to have some of the best seasons of TV ever, praised for their grit, writing, and masterclass-level performances.

item.title: Nintendo Is Officially Investing in Game Preservation
item.description: Game preservation has always been one of the biggest problems facing the industry. According to the Video Game History Foundation , 87% of classic video games released in the United States are critically endangered or lost. This has forced many who want to maintain that history to turn to piracy, a last resort that has become a necessity due to the minimal efforts of large corporations to adequately preserve their catalog of games and technology. Thankfully, one of gaming's biggest names is officially getting in on the preservation effort.
